t: This is Queen Mary's Steps, a surviving fragment of the old Palace of Whitehall. It is a small remnant of a much larger royal complex, and it is credited to Sir Christopher Wren. Wren was an architect, astronomer and mathematician, and he is best known for rebuilding fifty-two City churches after the Great Fire of 1666, including St Paul's Cathedral, which he completed in 1710. Look at the stonework here and think of it as a piece of a vanished palace.
